page.overview:
Who is Emoth Kade?

() is a half-elf noblewoman of Jrusar. As an NPC, is played by Matthew Mercer.

Emoth is pale and very thin. Her hair is dark and very curly and voluminous. When she first appeared, she wore a long gray dress with a train.

After the transformation, her body lost some reproductive features, and breathing holes opened in her back and her shoulders.

After her complete transformation, Imogen Temult could sense a lot of feral anger and a strong devotion to the Shade Mother.
